approvals.note: Multilingual EN+RU+ES candidate. Corpus 53 -> 72 rows, a delta of exactly 19, all of them localized. Decomposition: 19 localized rows added = 17 recognizable (15 expected resolved + 2 expected partial) + 2 deliberate unknown-marker rows (ru-unknown-marker, es-unknown-marker). No English row was added: the English segment grew from 20 to 53 solely because 33 English-labelled rows were re-pointed from the RU-tagged documents onto cbc-en-north and specialty-en-central, with their labels, units, values and expected classifications byte-identical. Final segments en 53 / ru 9 / es 10 = 72. falseConcreteResolutions 0 aggregate and 0 in each of en/ru/es. expectedClassificationRate 1.0: all 72 rows match their declared expectation, including both unknown-marker rows which stay unmapped. The 2 expected-unmapped rows are excluded from the recognition, alias and unit coverage denominators, which is why those rates remain 1.0; their safety is asserted by expectedClassificationRate and falseConcreteResolutions instead. Catalog digest moved from 5341c12e to 0958b279 because alias normalized forms are recomputed with normalizeMeasurementLabel and every alias now declares a locale.

72 rows, resolved 23 / partial 47 / unmapped 2 / ambiguous 0. rawPreservationRate 1.0, recognitionRate 1.0, expectedClassificationRate 1.0, aliasCoverageRate 1.0, unitCoverageRate 1.0, falseConcreteResolutions 0, processingErrors 0, unclassifiedRows 0. 17 threshold checks pass, including per-language gates for en (53 rows), ru (9 rows) and es (10 rows). Catalog manifest 2026-08-03.0 -> 2026-08-09.0, resolver version 10 -> 11, normalization version 6 -> 7. Policy changes in this candidate: requiredLaunchRows 53 -> 72, a new languageThresholds block, and scoreAffectingBindingOwners extended to the 13 definitions the corpus actually reaches; the unreachable crp_serum owner entry was removed so the policy describes the current release surface only. Launchability inputs per the release-gate contract are fixture validity, threshold checks and hash-bound approvals; test suites are supporting engineering evidence and are not inputs to the manifest. Evidence reviewed: tsc --noEmit clean; 33 TypeScript verifiers pass; 16 of 17 pgTAP suites pass. Three failures are pre-existing and unrelated, reproduced on a clean baseline at HEAD ae2fe70 and recorded in issue #110 and QA/issue-114/checklist.md: test:eh111 line 184, verify-postgrest-revision-embeds, and pr2_instrumental_canonicalization test 6. No waiver is invoked because none of the three is a gate input; each is asserted unchanged against baseline rather than excused. Governance note for this candidate: one Project Owner acts in the registry-safety-reviewer, release-manager and assessment-owner roles, which the current policy permits and existing approval precedent follows; separating those roles is tracked as a follow-up governance improvement and is deliberately out of scope here.
